article.title: U.S. birth rate drops to record low, but older women are having more babies
article.description: The U.S. birth rate fell to its lowest level ever recorded, according to a report from the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention. The drop would have been greater, but women over age 30 are having more children.

summary.zh_title: 美国出生率降至历史低点，但年长女性生育更多
summary.zh_summary: 根据疾病控制和预防中心的报告，美国出生率降至历史最低水平，但30岁以上女性的生育率有所上升。
summary.en_title: U.S. birth rate drops to record low, but older women are having more babies
summary.en_summary: The U.S. birth rate fell to its lowest level ever recorded, according to a report from the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention.

article.title: Russia steps up election influence efforts in final stretch of midterms
article.description: Researchers who track online influence operations say Kremlin-backed groups are renewing tactics they've used to sow distrust and discord in previous elections in the U.S. and around the world.

article.title: This design software reimagines everyday objects as self-aware devices
article.description: “X-Hinges” helps design and 3D print items like lamps and gloves with an interactive twist: automatically embedded sensors that perceive and adaptively respond to human contact.

summary.en_summary: “X-Hinges” helps design and 3D print items like lamps and gloves with an interactive twist: automatically embedded sensors that perceive and adaptively respond to human contact.
